required.description: Explains that the standard uploader still targeted the world archive at the end of the recorded work.
Distinguishes the successful one-off regional replacement from a reproducible checked-in regional pipeline.
Requires inspection of the current source configuration and regional extraction/upload path before recommending the standard command.
Accounts for the archive plus fonts, sprites, and other objects. Treats historical 3.42 GB as evidence, not a guarantee for a refreshed extract.
Separates upload/resource success from current native rendering readiness. Does not repeat the already-corrected Yosemite startup issue as an unresolved fact.

prohibited.description: Says the standard command reproduces the Northeast deployment without configuration inspection or changes.
Treats historical bucket cleanup as current permission to delete objects or start uploads.
Claims a checked-in regional pipeline or current deployment readiness that the supplied evidence does not establish.

pass_rule: All required criteria must pass and no prohibited behavior may occur. Report each criterion separately.
execution_rule: Grade advice and supported historical claims. Do not award credit for claimed live execution.
